name: Spark Savings USDC
oneLiner: spUSDC is Spark's ERC-4626 V2 savings wrapper of USDC; share price compounds the Vault Savings Rate while exits redeem from vault USDC liquidity.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: spUSDC resolves to Upstream because the wrapper holds USDC as its only reserve, inheriting Circle's blacklist surface.

collateral: USDC deposited into Spark Savings Vault V2 (ERC-4626 asset=USDC); idle USDC is deployed by the Spark Liquidity Layer. Spark documents V2 USD vaults as economically fully backed by USDS / Sky balance-sheet liquidity for redemptions.
pegMechanism: Deposit USDC to mint spUSDC; share price appreciates against USDC as the Vault Savings Rate (vsr) accrues while SLL deploys idle assets. Withdrawals burn spUSDC for USDC subject to vault idle liquidity or Savings Liquidity Intents for large exits.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Spark materials describe an ERC-4626 savings wrapper with USDC and Sky liquidity-layer exposure, but the complete current deployment-wide assurance, custody, valuation, reconciliation, and recovery semantics needed to resolve the mechanism archetype are not disclosed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Spark Savings USDC is tracked on Ethereum and Avalanche as a wrapper/variant of USDC. On-chain reads on 2026-07-20 confirm both deployments are local Spark ERC-4626 savings vaults over local USDC (immutable clones, zero proxy admin), so issuance is native per chain with inherited USDC exposure.

routes.reviewNote: On-chain 2026-07-20: 163-byte minimal proxy (implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455, EIP-1967 admin slot zero — no upgrade authority) of the Spark ERC-4626 savings vault with asset() = USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48; shares mint natively against local USDC deposits. The vault's DEFAULT_ADMIN is the Spark DAO SubProxy (SPARK_PROXY 0x3300f198988e4C9C63F75dF86De36421f06af8c4) per the Spark address registry. No bridge control carries the claim.

On-chain 2026-07-20: 163-byte minimal proxy (implementation 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12, EIP-1967 admin slot zero — no upgrade authority) of the Spark ERC-4626 savings vault with asset() = USDC 0xB97EF9Ef8734C71904D8002F8b6Bc66Dd9c48a6e; shares mint natively against local USDC deposits. The vault's DEFAULT_ADMIN is the Spark cross-chain governance executor (SPARK_EXECUTOR 0x7566DEbC906C17338524A414343fA61BcA26A843, driven from mainnet via the LZReceiver 0xd905be48983D405C6fD7f5a983D2351fb61C691F) per the Spark address registry. No bridge control carries the claim.

mintAuthority.summary: spUSDC shares are minted against deposited USDC in Spark's Ethereum and Avalanche ERC-4626 vaults and inherit Circle's reviewed USDC issuer mint authority. Both vaults are UUPS proxies: Ethereum upgrades resolve through Spark's SubProxy and Sky's 48-hour DSPause path, while Avalanche upgrades resolve through the Spark executor driven by its LayerZero governance receiver.

controls.label: Spark Savings USDC vault
controls.capDescription: ERC-4626 share accounting over deposited USDC; does not mint base USDC.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25579815, the vault was a 163-byte ERC-1967 UUPS proxy with implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455, zero admin and beacon slots, asset() = USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by Spark SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. Shares are deposit-backed and do not create base USDC.

controls.label: Spark Savings USDC Avalanche vault
controls.capDescription: ERC-4626 share accounting over deposited Avalanche-native USDC; does not mint base USDC.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90859314, the vault was a 163-byte ERC-1967 UUPS proxy with implementation 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12, zero admin and beacon slots, asset() = native USDC 0xb97ef9ef8734c71904d8002f8b6bc66dd9c48a6e, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by SPARK_EXECUTOR 0x7566DEbC906C17338524A414343fA61BcA26A843.

controls.label: Spark/Sky SubProxy upgrade governance (48-hour DSPause)
controls.capDescription: The SubProxy is the Ethereum vault's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member. Sky governance can replace the UUPS implementation or change deposit controls through the 48-hour DSPause path.
controls.evidence: The SparkVault UUPS authorization is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. At Ethereum block 25579815 that role was held by the Spark SubProxy; its arbitrary-execution path resolves through DSPauseProxy and DSPause with delay() = 172800 under Sky Chief governance, matching the independently reviewed spUSDT governance path.

controls.label: Spark Avalanche cross-chain governance executor
controls.capDescription: SPARK_EXECUTOR holds the Avalanche vault's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and receives authorized governance actions through Spark's LayerZero receiver.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90859314, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x7566DEbC906C17338524A414343fA61BcA26A843) on the spUSDC vault returned true. The Spark registry identifies that contract as SPARK_EXECUTOR and 0xd905be48983D405C6fD7f5a983D2351fb61C691F as its LayerZero governance receiver.

controls.label: Inherited Ethereum USDC MasterMinter
controls.evidence: Inherited from the verified `usdc-circle` mintAuthority. Circle's MasterMinter can authorize issuer minters and raise mint allowances; wrapper share issuance cannot bypass this base-supply authority.

review.evidence: Fixed-block reads on 2026-07-21 resolved both tracked wrapper deployments. At Ethereum block 25579815, spUSDC was a UUPS proxy using SparkVault implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455; its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder was the Spark SubProxy governed through Sky's 172800-second DSPause path. At Avalanche block 90859314, the same-address vault was a UUPS proxy using implementation 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12; its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder was SPARK_EXECUTOR, identified by the Spark registry with LayerZero receiver 0xd905be48983D405C6fD7f5a983D2351fb61C691F. Both asset() reads returned the local native USDC deployment. Wrapper shares remain deposit-backed; base supply authority, reconciliation, and supervision inherit from reviewed USDC.
